sections.heading: What Our Engine Matching Service Involves

blocks.html: When replacing or rebuilding a Mercedes-Benz engine, exact matching is critical. We use your vehicle's registration number and VIN to determine the precise engine specification that was originally fitted, ensuring full compatibility.

items: **VIN-based lookup** – we decode your vehicle's VIN to identify the original engine family, displacement, and tuning level.
**Engine number verification** – we check the first six characters of the engine number against the VIN's engine code to confirm identity.
**ECU compatibility** – Mercedes-Benz ECUs are VIN-locked; we ensure proper coding and reprogramming when needed.
**Ancillary verification** – we check that all supporting components (turbo, injectors, sensors) are also correctly matched to your vehicle.
**Full documentation** – we provide a detailed matching report for your records and warranty.

blocks.html: Our service is essential before any engine replacement or rebuild – mismatched engines can lead to poor performance, further failure, and invalid warranties.

steps.title: Obtain Registration / VIN
steps.body: We take your vehicle's registration number or VIN – either from you or directly from the vehicle.

steps.title: VIN Decoding
steps.body: Using Mercedes-Benz Xentry/Star Diagnosis, we decode the VIN to retrieve the original engine family, displacement, power output, and all relevant specifications.

steps.title: Engine Number Verification
steps.body: We locate the engine number on the cylinder block and compare the first six characters to the VIN's engine code – if they match, the engines are identical.

steps.title: Component Compatibility Check
steps.body: We verify that ancillary components (turbo, injectors, sensors, ECU) are compatible with the matched engine – these often vary between specifications.

steps.title: ECU Integration
steps.body: If the ECU is being replaced or reprogrammed, we ensure it is correctly VIN-locked and coded to your vehicle. We perform default initialisation to reset adaptation values.

steps.title: Documentation & Handover
steps.body: We provide a detailed report confirming the engine match, including VIN, engine number, and all verified specifications – for your records and warranty.

items.q: Why is engine matching by VIN so important?
items.a: Mercedes-Benz engines come in many different displacements and tuning levels – even within the same family (e.g., M272 has 2.5L, 3.0L, and 3.5L versions). The wrong engine can cause poor performance, drivability issues, and may not be covered by warranty. Matching by VIN ensures you get the exact engine your vehicle was designed for.

items.q: How do you verify the engine number?
items.a: We locate the engine number on the cylinder block (usually stamped on a flat surface) and compare the first six characters to the engine code derived from the VIN. If they match, the engines are identical. We also check the full number for any variations.

items.q: What is ECU VIN-locking and why does it matter?
items.a: Mercedes-Benz ECUs are programmed with the vehicle's VIN. A replacement ECU must be reprogrammed to match your VIN, or the vehicle may not start. Our diagnostic equipment allows us to perform this coding correctly.

items.q: Do you offer this service as a standalone, or only with a rebuild/replacement?
items.a: We offer engine matching as a standalone service – you can get a matching report to verify your current engine or to help source a replacement. We also integrate matching into our full rebuild and replacement services.

items.q: How long does the matching process take?
items.a: Typically within a few hours once we have access to the vehicle or the engine number. We can often decode the VIN remotely with just the registration or VIN number.

items.q: Can you match an engine if I only have the registration number?
items.a: Yes – we can use the registration number to look up the VIN and then decode the original engine specification. We still recommend verifying the physical engine number when the vehicle is with us.
